title: Set-valued tableaux and cells of Gelfand-Zetlin polytopes
summary: Two combinatorial rules are known for the Grassmannian Grothendieck polynomial $G^{(β)}_λ$: a sum over set-valued tableaux of shape $λ$, due to Buch, and a sum over the efficient cells of a cellular decomposition of the Gelfand-Zetlin polytope $GZ(λ)$, due to E. Presnova and the author. All coefficients in both sums equal $1$. We construct an explicit bijection between the two indexing sets which matches the summands term by term, carrying the number of excess entries of a tableau to the dimension of the corresponding cell; in particular the two rules are equivalent, either being deducible…
